spec.description: Compare the pages in a test. Click a bar to open the page in Page metrics.

spec.title: Google Web Vitals [$function]
spec.description: One row for each page. Each value is the average over the time range. Click a column header to sort, and a page to open it in Page metrics.

properties.value: Time to first byte: the time from the start of the navigation until the browser gets the first byte of the HTML. Good is below 800 ms.
When the first text or image is painted. Good is below 1.8 seconds.
When the largest image or text block in the viewport is painted. Good is below 2.5 seconds.
How much content moves around while the page loads. Good is below 0.1.
Time when long tasks block the main thread between First Contentful Paint and the end of the test. Good is below 200 ms.

spec.title: Visual metrics [$function]
spec.description: One row for each page. Each value is the average over the time range. Click a column header to sort, and a page to open it in Page metrics.

properties.value: The first visual change is when something for the first time is painted within the current viewport. It is calculated by analyzing a video recording of the screen.

The Speed Index is the average time at which visible parts of the page are displayed. It is expressed in milliseconds and dependent on size of the view port. It was created by Pat Meenan and you can checkout the full documentation [here](https://sites.google.com/a/webpagetest.org/docs/using-webpagetest/metrics/speed-index).
The largest image is the time when the largest image within the viewport is painted and on its final position. It is calculated by analyzing a video recording of the screen.
Visual readiness is the time between the first visual change and the last visual change within the viewport. It is calculated by analyzing a video recording of the screen.

spec.title: First Visual Change
spec.description: The first visual change is when something for the first time is painted within the current viewport. It is calculated by analyzing a video recording of the screen.

spec.title: Largest image
spec.description: The largest image is the time when the largest image within the viewport is painted and on its final position. It is calculated by analyzing a video recording of the screen.

spec.title: SpeedIndex
spec.description: The Speed Index is the average time at which visible parts of the page are displayed. It is expressed in milliseconds and dependent on size of the view port. It was created by Pat Meenan and you can checkout the full documentation [here](https://sites.google.com/a/webpagetest.org/docs/using-webpagetest/metrics/speed-index).

spec.title: Visual Readiness
spec.description: Visual readiness is the time between the first visual change and the last visual change within the viewport. It is calculated by analyzing a video recording of the screen.

spec.title: Timings [$function]
spec.description: One row for each page. Each value is the average over the time range. Click a column header to sort, and a page to open it in Page metrics.

properties.value: Load Event End is when the load event end event fires in the Navigation Timing API
Fully loaded time when the last of all assets is downloaded on the page.

spec.title: Load Event End
spec.description: When the load event ends: when the browser has downloaded and run all the resources in the HTML.

spec.title: Fully Loaded
spec.description: When the last request of the page has finished, from the HAR file. Third-party requests that load late make this number change much.

spec.title: CPU [$function]
spec.description: One row for each page. Each value is the average over the time range. Click a column header to sort, and a page to open it in Page metrics.

properties.value: The average number of CPU Long Tasks per page. A CPU long Task is by default a CPU task that takes longer than 50 ms to run. This metrics is Chrome only at the moment.
This is the longest CPU task for each page (if they are over 50 ms long). This metrics is Chrome only at the moment.
CPU time spent evaluating JavaScript. Calculated using [Tracium](https://github.com/aslushnikov/tracium). This is a Chrome only metric at the moment.
CPU time spent rendering the page. Calculated using [Tracium](https://github.com/aslushnikov/tracium). This is a Chrome only metric at the moment.

spec.title: Longest CPU Long Tasks
spec.description: The longest long task. During a long task, the browser cannot respond to user input. Chrome only.

spec.title: Number of CPU Long Tasks
spec.description: Number of long tasks (50 ms or more) on the main thread. During a long task, the browser cannot respond to user input. Chrome only.

spec.title: Number of CPU Long Tasks before First Paint
spec.description: Number of long tasks (50 ms or more) before first paint. Chrome only.

spec.title: Size and requests
spec.description: One row for each page. Each value is the average over the time range. Click a column header to sort, and a page to open it in Page metrics.

properties.value: Total number of requests for the full page.
Total page weight (compressed over the wire).
Transfer size of this content type: the size over the network, often compressed.
Third party requests are calculated using the [Third party web](https://github.com/patrickhulce/third-party-web) library.
Third party % are calculated using the [Third party web](https://github.com/patrickhulce/third-party-web) library.

spec.title: Requests
spec.description: Total number of requests for the page.

spec.title: Total transfer size
spec.description: Transfer size: the size of all requests over the network, often compressed.

spec.title: Quality [$function]
spec.description: One row for each page. Each value is the average over the time range. Click a column header to sort, and a page to open it in Page metrics.

properties.value: The performance score (0-100) calculated by the [Coach](https://www.sitespeed.io/documentation/coach/) using performance best practices.
The privacy score (0-100) calculated by the [Coach](https://www.sitespeed.io/documentation/coach/) using user privacy best practices.
Accessibility violations found by axe-core, by impact. Enable with --axe.enable.
Accessibility violations found by axe-core, by impact. Enable with --axe.enable.
The estimated carbon emission is calculated using the sustainable web plugin, developed together with the Green Web Foundation.
